items.why: Down with the chip complex. Higher bond yields weighed on semiconductors today, with Samsung, Micron, Taiwan Semi and Sandisk in focus, per Investor's Business Daily.
Oil jumping on the Iran strike-plan report and rising Treasury yields spooked risk assets, while about $550 million in leveraged crypto bets were liquidated, per CoinDesk.
Fell after hitting a record close of $239.24 on Tuesday. Higher bond yields pressured semis, and the stock kept fading Thursday morning, per Barron's.
Big Tech was broadly lower as rising oil prices and bond yields spooked investors. Barron's also flagged Wall Street nerves over Tesla's secrecy around the Optimus robot.

market_note: S&P futures down ~0.6%, Nasdaq futures down ~1.3%, oil up ~3%, VIX up 6%.
summary: Risk-off Thursday. Oil spiked on reports the White House asked the Pentagon for Iran strike options, reviving inflation fears, while rising Treasury yields pressured chips and megacaps. Bitcoin broke below $83K as $550M in leveraged crypto longs were liquidated.
